label: Coexisting term does not entail concurrent actualization, checked
description: Closed result with no premises: the universally quantified entailment from foundation, accompaniment, coexistence of the term and received onset being given to 40a97664 fails, at the interpretation of Control part 1 (a creator present at every moment who gives being at onset only, with the creature related to it afterwards). A countermodel shows non-entailment for the stated formal interpretation, not that any premise is false. It shows that the warrant for coexistence of the term (a real relation needs an existing term) does not reach giving at the moment; what is missing is giving by the term.
